# Prairie Bend Cooperative and Prairie Bend Meats — Food Defense and Emergency Plan (excerpt)

## Processing plant

Prairie Bend Meats operates under USDA inspection as Est. 4127. Production runs on Packaging Lines 1, 2 and 3 with a metal detector and checkweigher on each line. Finished product goes to Blast Freezer 2 and Cooler 5. Each pallet carries a lot code: Lot Code 24A118 is the first shift on Line 2.

The liquid sugar tank, Tank 6, is the actionable process step named in the vulnerability assessment. The FSIS Inspector-in-Charge reports to the FSIS District Office; reportable foods go to the Reportable Food Registry within 24 hours.

## Cooperative elevators

The cooperative receives grain at Elevators 1–4. Bins 11–18 at Elevator 2 hold corn; Silo 3 holds soybeans. Scale tickets print at each scale house.

## Livestock

The member feedlot reports suspected disease to the state veterinarian and APHIS. Poultry Houses 1–6 at the Hilltop farm have barn controllers with alarm dialers. Ammonia releases are reported to the National Response Center.
